name: Midnight Carnival
source:
Midnight Carnival is a Visual Novel with a dark and disturbing story and theme.

Brandon is a mentally unstable, antisocial young man ,suffering from deep depression. He craves a change in his life, but having no strength to make changes on his own, he hopes for miracle. Brandon will come to understand, that his miracle will come at a great cost.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/546980/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Midnight Carnival》是一部拥有黑暗、令人不安的故事与主题的视觉小说。

Brandon是一个精神不稳定、反社会的年轻人，长期饱受深度抑郁折磨。他渴望改变生活，却没有独自行动的力量，只能寄希望于奇迹。Brandon终将明白，他的奇迹需要付出巨大的代价。

（来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/546980/]Steam[/url]）
